Method of Attack: Self-replication by copying the executable on identified network shares
Creation of scheduled tasks on remote machines to execute the malware remotely
Propagation through Windows domain using scheduled tasks and Windows RPC accesses
Propagation by listing IP addresses in local ARP cache and sending Wake-on-LAN packets
Mounting and encrypting remote computers' drives
Discoverer: ANSSI (Agence Nationale de la Sécurité des Systèmes d'Information)
Impacted Systems: Windows devices on victims' local networks
